0022600111.text: The Phoenix Suns (0-1, 5th in the Pacific, 15th in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (0-2, 3rd in the Pacific, 13th in the West) in this regular-season game, Phoenix's second of the season. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), Oso Ighodaro (out, oblique strain), and Luke Kennard (day-to-day, knee strain, game-time decision), while Golden State is missing Al Horford (out, back), Brandin Podziemski (out, back), Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (out, rest), with Charles Bassey (knee) and Draymond Green (back) both listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Phoenix lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 101-97 home loss to Golden State on February 5, 2026.
